flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show a slight drop in the Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate, though they remain the favoured party. In [[Maine]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Troy Jackson saw a sizable drop in their chances. In [[Kansas]], also a predicted flip, the Democrat Adam Hamilton gained ground by a moderate amount.
summaries.governor: In [[Kansas]], Ty Masterson, the Republican, saw a sizable drop in chances, and the market lists it as a predicted flip. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford gained ground by a sizable margin, also a predicted flip. The Republican Phil Scott slipped by a sizable amount in [[Vermont]].
summaries.house: Polymarket odds still favour the Democrats to win the House, though their chances slipped slightly today. The market's projected seat count is now 241-194, up from 240-195, which means Democrats gain control, and [[VA-05 (Lynchburg & Charlottesville)]] is a newly predicted flip. Among individual races, the Republican Jeff Van Drew's chances in [[NJ-02 (Vineland & Atlantic City)]] fell sharply, while the Democrat Shannon Taylor gained sharply in [[VA-01 (Williamsburg & Poquoson)]], a predicted flip.
